reason: ChatQueueService.run woke every 0.5 s in every execution worker and each pass opened a worker transaction under the global execution advisory lock, about 70 % of an idle worker's lock acquisitions. The dispatcher now waits for a NebulaStore.on_follow_up_change signal (queue writes; turn activity in conversations whose queue waits on a turn), keeps the 0.5 s recheck only while a queue waits on a running response, parks queues that only wait for a turn status change (linked reviews, and follow-ups behind their own or the conversation's latest response awaiting an approval or callback), runs a 30 s safety pass and retries failed queue reads. Selected: the follow-up dispatcher and polling-cost tests (new run()-driven wake, end-to-end dispatch, parking, unrelated-activity, safety-pass, read-failure and store-signal tests), every follow-up queue test and the store transaction suites, because NebulaStore.transaction now signals from a finally block.
